method: Exact accepted16px and candidateaxis-rejection binaries in isolated stockNTSC Mesen. Same scripted controls, initial camera, simulated50Hzphase, setup/hold/release lengths and verified matching terminal camera poses.

Input-to-first-view timing starts at Mesen inputPolled and ends at associated changed viewport observation; physical controller/OS/display latency is excluded. Publication timing is separately recorded.

Changed-picture full-window rate counts unique changing camera publications during exact input-poll torelease interval, including startup wait. Consecutive changed-publication intervalrate excludes that startup wait. Both use counts and elapsedtime; stationary actor redraws do not count.
Live routes rotate across changing view complexity with realAI and music; they are region-started routes, not invariant cameraFPS or causal CPU comparisons. Fixed-snapshot CPU tests are separate.
